title: Energy Control Vanilla Pack
description: Energy Control Vanilla Pack - Is a vanilla resource pack for the mod
body:
## NOTE This texture pack will no longer be updated. It has been merged with the All Industry New Pack! 
https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/all-industry-new-pack


### **Energy Control Vanilla Pack** - Is a vanilla resource pack for the mod Energy Control

In the original version of the mod, are in my opinion terrible textures, and I decided to draw how they would look like in 16x16 resolution. I wanted to offer the developer new textures, but unfortunately he just deleted my comment with a link to the YouTube channel. I think there will be people who really want to play with vanilla textures.

Energy Control — is a remastered version of original Nuclear Control
[Original Mod Energy Control](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/energy-control)
